Official standings after Sunday's US Grand Prix in Austin (25 Oct) leave FIVE Grands Prix remaining with Russell on 242, Hamilton 241 (1 point back, not 9!), Verstappen 236 and Leclerc 233.

flags.title: OLBG displays 'Tie' as Most Popular Tip on 13 of 15 Handball matches (43%–78% share)
flags.detail: Handball draws occur in roughly 8%–10% of EHF Champions League matches, yet OLBG's hub surfaces 'Tie' with 9/14 tips on unbeaten Magdeburg vs Kriens-Luzern and 7/9 on PSG vs Aalborg. We discard OLBG's Tie crowd split and originate 3-way 1X2, Handicap and Total lines directly from official EHF group goal differentials.

flags.title: OLBG prints unlabeled UTC-4 (EDT) timestamps across global fixtures
flags.detail: OLBG displays EHF Champions League 18:45 CET games as 13:45 (5-hour gap, since CET = UTC+1 and EDT = UTC-4), MLB Game 4 (20:00 EDT) as 'Today 21:00' (1-hour discrepancy), and caused 14 late-night EDT rows in data/events.json to be misdated by 1 UTC day.

flags.title: Milwaukee Brewers Game 4 starting pitcher unannounced (left blank)
flags.detail: MLB.com probable pitchers confirms RHP Griffin Jax (0-1, 6.00 ERA) for Tampa Bay in World Series Game 4, while Milwaukee's starter remains officially listed as TBD. We leave Milwaukee's starter blank rather than speculating.

flags.title: Three morning 27 Oct internationals started at 07:00–08:00 UTC and are excluded from pre-match picks
flags.detail: NZ vs India 3rd T20I, Namibia vs Ireland 3rd ODI, and Pakistan vs Sri Lanka ODI remained listed on OLBG's hub after play began. Their originated lines are preserved in the full market inventory with an 'in-play / started earlier' flag, while written picks use only upcoming matches.

flags.title: European/domestic league official injury sheets not centrally published — left blank
flags.detail: Unlike the NBA and NHL (where official injury/IR reports are published daily and integrated into every game row), EuroLeague, EuroCup, Pro D2, domestic volleyball and domestic cricket clubs do not publish centralized pre-match injury lists 24–72 hours out. Those injury cells are intentionally left blank rather than guessed.

flags.title: Baseball has only 1 active event worldwide on OLBG (World Series Game 4)
flags.detail: On 27 October 2026, MLB World Series Game 4 (MIL @ TB) is the sole baseball fixture on OLBG, offering 3 distinct markets (Money Line, Run Line, Game Totals). All 3 markets are priced and written up; no phantom fixtures were added to pad Baseball to five picks.

flags.title: OLBG server HTML omits live bookmaker fractional/decimal odds
flags.detail: Unauthenticated OLBG HTML exposes event IDs, market structures, handicap/total lines and win-tip counts, but injects bookmaker prices client-side. Every price on this dashboard is our own originated price.
